[RLOW.5.6.5.3] That exclusion says: no other anchor that excludes it
with the same followers ([LTHE.2.5.3]) exists with a timestamp strictly between the anchor's and the
first follower's. It reduces the activation set to the single latest qualifying
anchor per follower match. The test compares timestamps, not arrival order, so an
anchor whose `ts` is not before the first follower's never excludes a match,
whenever it was asserted ([LTHE.2.5.3]).
